name: 47-Piece Foldable Wireless Electric Screwdriver Kit with Adjustable Torque & USB Charging
description:
Upgrade your toolbox with the 47-Piece Foldable Wireless Electric Screwdriver Kit. Built with a 1500mAh rechargeable battery and adjustable torque settings, it delivers reliable power and precision for home, DIY, and professional tasks. Its foldable design makes it perfect for working in tight spaces, while the lightweight body ensures easy handling for everyone. With 45 screwdriver bits, a flexible bending head, and USB charging, it’s the ultimate compact repair companion.
Key Features
 1500mAh rechargeable battery for long-lasting use
 Adjustable torque for precision and control
 Foldable design to reach tight spaces easily
 Includes 45 screwdriver bits + flexible bending head
 Lightweight, durable, and easy to handle
 USB charging for convenience anywhere
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, metal alloy, rechargeable lithium battery
How to Use
 Charge the screwdriver with the included USB cable
 Select the desired screwdriver bit and attach it securely
 Adjust torque settings as required
 Use foldable or straight mode based on working space
 Recharge when battery runs low
Package Includes
 1 × Wireless Electric Screwdriver
 1 × Flexible Bending Head
 45 × Screwdriver Bits
 1 × USB Charging Cable
